name: Mount Athos
description: Mount Athos is a rugged peninsula in northeastern Greece, jutting into the Aegean Sea, where about 20 working monasteries cling to cliffs and wooded slopes. Monks have lived here since Byzantine times, and today around 1,400 follow the Orthodox way of life. The monastic community governs itself and bars women from entering. Its fortress-like complexes and icon paintings shaped Orthodox art as far away as Russia.
